description.para: Determine canopy, fire, and foliage shape distribution parameters

Determines the canopy, fire, and foliage shape distribution parameters based on vegetation type, canopy characteristics, and forest fraction. Maps vegetation types to Massman et al. (2017) forest classifications.
VTYPE
Grid cell dominant vegetation type
FCH
Grid cell canopy height (m)
FFRAC
Grid cell forest fraction
LAI
Grid cell leaf area index
PAI_OPT
Integer for PAI values used or calculated (default = 0)
PAI_SET
Real value for PAI set values used (default = 4.0)
LU_OPT
Integer for LU type from model mapped to Massman et al. (default = 0/VIIRS)
FIRETYPE
1 = Above Canopy Fire; 0 = Below Canopy Fire; -1 No Canopy [output]
CDRAG
Drag coefficient (nondimensional) [output]
PAI
Plant/foliage area index (nondimensional) [output]
ZCANMAX
Height of maximum foliage area density (z/h) (nondimensional) [output]
SIGMAU
Standard deviation of shape function above zcanmax (z/h) [output]
SIGMA1
Standard deviation of shape function below zcanmax (z/h) [output]
P.C. Campbell
June 2022
Based on Massman et al. (2017) algorithms
